section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the factor structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) among Indonesian women (n=262) and men (n=278) in Jakarta, Indonesia. The study found a two-factor solution for the BAS among this non-Western population, with a dominant 10-item factor representing general body appreciation and a secondary 3-item factor representing adaptive body image investment. Men reported significantly higher body appreciation than women, with no significant ethnic differences observed.
